children: announced on Tuesday that its fall Target Circle Deal Days event will run October 6–7 in a direct challenge to Amazon's

Prime Big Deal Days shopping event. The retailer will offer Target Circle members up to 40% off thousands of products. The promotion spans fall apparel, home décor, kitchen tools, beauty, toys, technology, and early holiday merchandise. As a perk, Target Circle 360 members can begin shopping select offers on October 5.

The Minneapolis-based company's strategy is focused on budget-conscious seasonal shopping, such as replacing summer clothing, refreshing homes for fall, and starting holiday gift purchases early. Promoted offers include 40% off select family apparel and outdoor holiday décor, 30% off selected Threshold furniture and Hearth & Hand with Magnolia products, discounts on select Dyson vacuums, and savings of up to 40% on toys, laptops, and other tech. Target
also aims to use the event to recruit and deepen loyalty membership.

The annual fall sales event evolved from Target Circle Week, a longer loyalty-sale format. In fall 2025, Target held a seven-day Circle Week from October 5–11, featuring discounts of up to 50% and daily deals.
